## What's new

Threadnote 5.1.0-beta.1 makes agent context retrieval more token-efficient, with clearer bounded continuations and reliable code-graph evidence while work continues in the background.

### More efficient context retrieval

- Context Brief projects compact, task-relevant memory evidence and returns a bounded continuation when more detail is available.
- Agents can continue from ready code-graph evidence while refresh and maintenance work proceeds.

### More dependable agent workflows

- MCP code-graph requests use consistent defaults for safer, predictable retrieval.
- The matched evaluation workflow now measures token efficiency with stricter, deterministic calibration evidence.
